data.title: Healthy corals help bleached neighbors regain color: study
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The world's coral reefs face an existential threat from rising seawater temperatures that trigger widespread bleaching, a problem driven by climate change and compounded by this year's intense El Nino phenomenon.

data.title: Indonesia rescues starved orangutan from fires: officials
data.description: INDONESIA - A female orangutan who was likely starving was evacuated Wednesday from an area razed by fire on the Indonesian island of Borneo, officials said, as the country rescues hundreds of animals affected by the blazes.

data.title: In Chicago, pope's hometown, Catholics express shock and support
data.description: CHICAGO (UNITED STATES) - Priests and parishioners in Pope Leo XIV's hometown of Chicago expressed shock, support and hope Wednesday after doctors discovered that a nodule removed from his lung was cancerous.

data.title: US Treasury chief urges stronger IMF role against 'distortionary policies'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called Wednesday for the IMF to do more in tackling "distortionary policies" that impact competition, a comment that appears directed at China.

data.title: Trump's new press secretary faces scrutiny over credentials
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The White House was facing mounting questions Wednesday over new press secretary Katie Zacharia's legal credentials, after a faltering first day in the job when she gave an inconclusive answer about where she had passed the bar exam.

data.title: Musk suggests US govt behind any slowdown in Ukraine's Starshield system
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - SpaceX boss Elon Musk said Wednesday that any disruptions reported by Ukraine in using the Starshield satellite communications system would be the responsibility of the US government, not his company.

data.title: Colombia opens embassy to Israel in Jerusalem
data.description: JERUSALEM - Colombia on Wednesday officially opened its embassy in Jerusalem, joining a small group of countries including the United States in taking the symbolic step of backing Israeli sovereignty in the contested holy city.

data.title: Government buildings torched in violent Albanian protests
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Anti-government protests in Albania's capital left several official buildings badly damaged and at least one on fire on Wednesday as demonstrations spiralled into violence for a second straight night.

data.title: Restrictions expose Ukraine's Starlink dependency in Russia war: observers
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Restrictions reported by Ukraine on its use of the US satellite internet system Starlink have exposed Kyiv's reliance on the technology for both offensive and defensive operations in its fight against Russia'a invasion, analysts and observers say.

data.title: Chiclayo prays for recovery and return of the 'Peruvian pope'
data.description: CHICLAYO (PERU) - In northern Peru, the self-anointed "city of Pope Leo XIV" is feverishly preparing for a visit by its former bishop, despite the pontiff's lung cancer diagnosis raising doubts over his travel plans.

data.title: Ukraine war reaches shores of Bulgarian fishing village
data.description: KRAPETS (BULGARIA) - After a series of drone attacks on ships off the coast, the conflict in Ukraine has taken on a new immediacy for residents of Krapets, a tiny Bulgarian Black Sea fishing village.

data.title: Macron: French protesters ‘exploited’ by political forces
data.description: PARIS - French President Emmanuel Macron believes students waging three weeks of protests that have closed many schools have “legitimate” grievances but are also being “exploited” by political forces, a government spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

data.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosque in West Bank
data.description: MIKHMAS, Palestinian Territories - Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque and graffitied its outside walls on Wednesday in the occupied West Bank village of Mikhmas, Palestinian sources and the Israeli military said.

data.title: Drone hits data centre of Russia’s largest bank
data.description: MOSCOW - A drone hit a data centre belonging to the Russian state-owned lender Sberbank, a company executive said Wednesday, though the bank’s systems and services were operating normally.

data.title: Pope recovering after lung cancer operation
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV began post-surgery recovery on Wednesday after a tumour removed from his lung was found to be cancerous, plunging the Catholic Church into a period of uncertainty.

data.title: Indonesian haze causes spike in Singapore pollution
data.description: SINGAPORE - Air pollution in parts of Singapore hit the country’s “very high” band on Wednesday while Timor-Leste shut schools, as haze from forest fires raging in Indonesia causes a regional crisis.

data.title: Fuel shortage triggers queues on Bali
data.description: DENPASAR, Indonesia - Moldovan tourist Raisa Neagu spent hours on Wednesday waiting to fuel up her scooter, one of many people snared in a petrol shortage on resort island Bali that authorities blamed on supply disruptions.

data.title: Zelensky accuses Putin of disrespecting Trump
data.description: KYIV - Ukraine on Wednesday accused Russia of wilfully flouting Donald Trump’s purported “energy ceasefire” and passing up an opportunity to ease hostilities, after a renewed wave of deadly strikes across the country that also hit vital power supplies.

data.title: China-North Korea bridge to open 12 years late
data.description: BEIJING - A new bridge linking China and North Korea will finally open on Thursday, 12 years after its construction, with Beijing vowing it will spur trade and “enhance the well-being of the two peoples”.

data.title: Trump touts ‘massive’ oil and mineral exploration in Greenland
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump said Wednesday that oil, gas and mineral exploration was preparing to begin in Greenland, and hailed the Arctic island’s position for US and European security.

data.title: Indian ‘cockroach’ leaders sent to jail after protest
data.description: NEW DELHI - Two leaders of India’s youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) were remanded in custody for five days on Wednesday, as police racheted up efforts to clamp down on anti-election commission protests.

data.title: IMF chief says Saudi attacks could have negative spillover 'everywhere'
data.description: International Monetary Fund head Kristalina Georgieva said Wednesday that recent attacks on Saudi Arabia could impact people "everywhere", as conflict in the energy-rich region adds to wide-ranging economic concerns.

data.title: Ukraine ex-military officer to stand trial over Nord Stream sabotage
data.description: HAMBURG - A former Ukrainian military officer is set to become the first person to stand trial over the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings as proceedings began in a German court Wednesday.

data.title: China heads for record trade surplus as exports surge
data.description: BEIJING - China's exports soared in September, official data showed Wednesday, putting it on course for a record annual trade surplus -- and likely more friction with the European Union and the United States.

data.title: South Korean FA condemns 'personal attacks' as rift rumours grow
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's football association has told fans to stop "excessive personal attacks", warning of the "psychological burden" it could inflict on national team players in the crosshairs since their World Cup flop.
